subject: Finalizing MAP: acceptance safety nets & close rituals
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novamed.com>, Ben Howard <ben.howard@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Finalizing MAP: acceptance safety nets & close rituals

Team —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a concise acceptance runbook and a set of "safety nets" we think will reduce risk during the evaluation cutover. Please find the attached AcceptanceMatrix_v1.xlsx (column-level acceptance signals + owner) and the short agenda below.

High-level asks (for the MAP):
- Confirm the acceptance thresholds for: accuracy concordance, latency tail p95, and token-level hallucination sampling.
- Confirm evidence owners for each exit gate (who will drop artifacts into the evidence folder).
- Procurement: confirm milestone billing and when Novamed will sign the mutual action form.

Proposed exit gates and rituals (short):
1) Smoke gate (day-of): basic traffic run, health checks, and end-to-end verification (owner: Marissa).
2) Sample concordance gate (48h window): 500 representative queries, manual review sample of 50 (owner: Novamed QA) — threshold: >= 92% concordance.
3) Latency SLO gate (continuous): p95 <= 450ms for masked production profile — 2-hour sampling window.
4) Rollback trigger: any data exfil / PII leakage incident or >5% drop in concordance vs. baseline.

Close rituals (what happens if gates pass):
- Immediately after smoke gate, we run the evidence snapshot script and upload artifacts to the shared drive.
- Post-acceptance handshake call at T+24h to confirm cutover cadence and start reserved capacity (if applicable).

Meeting: propose 45m on Fri Nov 20 10:00 PST to lock thresholds and owners. If that works for Novamed procurement, we'll add the mutual action signature to the HubSpot deal and schedule the smoke run.

Next steps (please reply with):
- Emily / Ben: confirm sampling and concordance threshold (or propose edits).
- Procurement: confirm whether the milestone invoice aligns with the MAP dates.
- Marissa: will you own smoke gate runbook?

Attachments: AcceptanceMatrix_v1.xlsx (baseline), small artifact checklist in-sheet.

—
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0118
Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novamed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Howard <ben.howard@novamed.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Finalizing MAP: acceptance safety nets & close rituals

Thanks — this is a great start, Karthik. A few quick notes from our side:

- Concordance threshold: we can accept 92% for the first pass but would like to see a plan to iterate to >=95% within the next two sprints. Can you add a guardrail that flags drift between runs?
- Sampling: 500 queries looks fine; for manual review can we stratify by intent (clinical vs administrative) so we don't accidentally bias the sample?
- Latency: p95 <=450ms aligns with our goal, but we need a fallthrough plan for spikes during bulk imports. Suggest an additional traffic-quarantine that routes bulk jobs to a low-priority queue during the 48h sample window.

Procurement (cc): can you confirm the milestone language? If the acceptance signoff is the milestone, we need to ensure billing triggers 48–72h after post-acceptance handshake to avoid premature invoicing.

Can we meet Fri Nov 20 10:00 PST — Ben and I are tentatively free.

Emily — thanks for the quick feedback. I updated the matrix and attached AcceptanceMatrix_v2.xlsx and a short SafetyNets_Runbook.pdf that describes the traffic-quarantine approach you suggested. Key changes: 

- Concordance guardrail: added a delta flag that alerts if concordance drops >2% between consecutive 24h windows; escalates to Priyom for investigation and temporary rate limiting.
- Sampling stratification: sample logic will pull 60% clinical / 40% administrative to match your production mix (configurable).
- Latency big-job plan: traffic-quarantine route defined; during sampling windows bulk jobs are tagged and routed to low-priority bursts.

Owners and immediate actions:
- Marissa: own smoke gate runbook and run the evidence snapshot script (artifact path = Drive /Novamed/DEAL-7893/evidence).
- Priyom: own the concordance guardrail implementation and will deliver a short runbook (ETA: Nov 20 08:00 PST).
- Karthik: will run the first smoke gate with Novamed and capture artifacts.

HubSpot / procurement: I linked the deal here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/7893 — if procurement confirms the milestone language (acceptance signoff -> invoice at T+48–72h), we'll add the signature block to the MAP and mark target dates.

I can hold the 45m slot on Fri Nov 20 10:00 PST — I will circulate a short meeting agenda and pre-reads (AcceptanceMatrix_v2.xlsx + SafetyNets_Runbook.pdf).
